differences.reason: FDK outputs 34,816 samples at 22,050 Hz where the analyzer counts 69,632 at 44,100 Hz (the rate ratio is 22050/44100: the same duration when the counts are in that ratio); the decoders disagree on whether SBR is applied
differences.note: decided 2026-11-02 (the project lead delegated the AAC calls to the main session): keep for now. The owners' decoders disagree: FDK decodes at the core rate without SBR (22,050 Hz), the analyzer, ffmpeg and Core Audio count SBR (44,100 Hz). Revisited with Core Audio's column in step 5.
